entities.summary: Nikolay Vassilev Vassilev is a Bulgarian politician and economist, who has been part of two governments of Bulgaria. He is a former member of National Movement for Stability and Progress and served as Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of the Economy (2001–2003), Vice Prime Minister and Minister of Transport and Communications (2003–2005), and Minister of State Administration and Administrative Reform (2005–2009).
